subject: music
title: Notes & Rests
welcome_lead: Drawing the symbols that spell out music.
meta_desc: KS3 notation: writing notes and rests properly.
final_note: Every musical sound and silence has its own symbol.

walkthroughs.body_html: A note has a notehead (oval), a stem (line), and may have tails or beams. Stems point up if note is below middle line, down if above.
Single quavers have a tail. When written in groups, the tails join into a beam across the top of the stems. Two quavers = one crotchet.
Every note value has a matching rest. Whole rest hangs below a line. Half rest sits on a line. Crotchet rest is a squiggle. Quaver rest looks like a 7.
